verdict_reason: Moving the organisation id and header constants into trader-api-headers is correct, but the leftover re-export gives E2E_ORGANISATION_ID a second import path that the new animals spec uses.

todos.issue: export { E2E_ORGANISATION_ID } (line 8) re-exports the constant now owned by adapters/http/trader-api-headers.ts, giving it two import paths. The PR's own new specs split across them: tests/animals/security/backend/organisation-scoped-notifications.spec.ts:2 imports it from '@adapters/http/address-book-api-client' (a notifications test reaching into the address-book client for it), while tests/plants/security/backend/organisation-scoped-notifications.spec.ts:2 and notification-api-client.ts:3 import it from '@adapters/http/trader-api-headers'. The animals spec is the re-export's only consumer.
todos.fix: Must: E2E_ORGANISATION_ID has one import path, trader-api-headers, and every consumer uses it. One way: delete line 8's re-export and change the animals organisation-scoped-notifications spec to import from '@adapters/http/trader-api-headers'.
